description: Datasets the continuous pipeline may ingest. A source is only fetched and used if it is declared here with a readout direction and a label threshold, because turning a continuous readout into a toxic/not label is a modelling decision and must not be made by a downloader.

rules.direction_required: Every toxicity source states higher_is_toxic or lower_is_toxic. A source without one is skipped, not guessed.
rules.efficacy_never_labelled_toxic: Potency readouts carry kind=efficacy and are excluded from toxicity training.
rules.licence_required: A source is only fetched when redistribution or local use is permitted and stated here.
rules.no_auto_promotion: Fetching data cannot promote an endpoint. Tiers are recomputed by scripts/derive_evidence_tiers.py from the evidence, every run.

sources.name: oligogym_cns_moe_neurotox
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 via OligoGym; see data/oligogym/ATTRIBUTION.md
sources.notes: In vivo functional observational battery. Half of the CNS endpoint.

sources.name: oligogym_cns_hagedorn_calcium
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 via OligoGym; see data/oligogym/ATTRIBUTION.md
sources.notes: In vitro calcium oscillation, LNA gapmers. Toxicity REDUCES oscillation, so the direction is inverted relative to the shipped combined file.

sources.name: oligogym_mcquisten_activity
sources.notes: Potency, not toxicity. Trains the ASO activity model only.

sources.name: oligogym_ichihara_potency
sources.notes: siRNA duplexes written sense.antisense in one field; the normalizer splits them.

sources.name: nar2022_gapmer_hepatotox_screen
sources.fetch_note: Supplementary Table S1 is a PDF behind a signed URL that expires. Open the article page, download the supplement, then run scripts/evaluate_hepatotox_external.py against it.
sources.licence: Open access article; the extracted table is a small factual dataset redistributed with citation
sources.notes: External check only. 5 positives cannot validate an endpoint, and the pipeline treats it as directional.

sources.name: asoptimizer_rodent_alt_ast
sources.notes: Roughly 6,000 curated rodent experiments, described as a future release. The single highest-value source for this platform; see docs/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Threshold to be set once the readout scale is known.

sources.name: aso_atlas_patent_gapmers
sources.notes: 188,521 gapmer sequences from USPTO patents. Availability not confirmed; a landing-page check returned HTTP 429.

sources.name: open_tggates_liver
sources.notes: Small molecules, not oligonucleotides. Usable only as a hepatotoxicity prior, which needs enough oligo labels to fine-tune against. Deferred behind asoptimizer_rodent_alt_ast.
